name: My Heart Says Yes Tee
note:
An ecru oversized tee with a small burgundy statement across the chest and a clean back. The warm neutral base and compact typography keep the look understated. Pair it with blue denim or darker trousers.

240 GSM, 100% super-combed cotton. Pre-shrunk and bio-washed, with a Lycra-ribbed neckline and double-stitched construction. Full-length, unisex oversized fit.
